entities.summary: Eduard Hempel was a German diplomat. He was the representative of Nazi Germany to Ireland between 1937 and 1945, in the build-up to and during The Emergency in Second World War. When appointed to the post, Hempel was not a Nazi Party member. However, the Nazi regime soon put him under pressure to join the party, which occurred on 1 July 1938.
